title: Barca are 22/23 Liga Endesa champions
description: Real Madrid - Barca 82-93 Barca conquered Liga Endesa 22/23 title. They beat Real in Madrid tonight to complete the sweep of the championship series. The victory marked the 20th ACB title for the Catalan team. The guests trailed by 3 points at the halftime before their 55-41 charge in the second half, which allowed them to win the game. Barca looked well-organized offensively handing out 21 assists. It was a good game for Czech center Jan Vesely (213-1990) who led his team to a victory with 19 points. The former international Nikola Mirotic (208-1991) contributed with 14 points and 5 rebounds for the winners. Four Barca players scored in double figures. Naturalized Cape Verdean center Walter Tavares (220-1992) answered with a double-double by scoring 19 points and 11 rebounds and French Guerschon Yabusele (204-1995) added 10 points in the effort for Real Madrid.
